title: groundgate review answer, format answer@1
description: What one reviewer gives for one task: one record of the answer log of a packet and a reviewer (docs/design/review.md section 5.3). The store adds sequence, previous and entry_sha256. This schema does not check the answer against its task: that a decision is a choice of the task, that a task with two or more choices gets no confirm, or that the candidate names the field and the key of the slot.

verdict.description: confirm: the only choice is right. choose: the choice in decision is right. correct: no choice is right, and candidate gives the right value. adjust_span: the value is right, and candidate gives its span. not_in_document: the document does not give the field. unsure: the person cannot tell.

decision.description: For choose, the index in the receipt of the chosen decision. Otherwise null.

candidate.description: For correct and adjust_span, a candidate (SPEC.md section 2.5, candidate.schema.json) with the person as proposer. Otherwise null.

codes_kept.description: Each code of a correction that the person saw and kept.

statements.description: Reserved for the model_text kind (section 7): a verdict for each statement of the task. null in format 1.

nodes.description: Reserved for the structure kind (section 7): each node that the person accepted or corrected. The correction of a node comes with the document model (#285). null in format 1.

reason_seen.description: true when the person opened the reason before the answer. For the measures only.

keys.description: The keys that the person pressed for this answer. For the measures only.

ms.description: The time on the task in milliseconds. For the measures only.

time.description: The UTC time of the answer. For the measures only: the resolution never reads it.
